predecessors.name: Chagatai Khanate
predecessors.text: the western half of the Chagatai ulus, ruled by Qazan Khan until 1346

successors.name: Timurid Empire
successors.text: Transoxiana and Balkh, where Timur was crowned in April 1370

ledger.x: 1346: Amir Qazaghan kills Qazan Khan and rules Transoxiana.
1358: Qazaghan is assassinated by the son of Borolday and Herat's tribute ends with him; neither page says when it stopped.
1361: Transoxiana goes to Moghulistan under Tughlugh Timur and then Ilyas Khoja; only Husayn's following in Afghanistan remains.
1363: Timur and Amir Husayn retake Transoxiana.
9 April 1370: Timur is crowned at Balkh.

wars.name: Moghul conquest of Transoxiana
wars.outcome: Tughlugh Timur of Moghulistan invaded in 1360 and 'conquered it'; Hajji Beg was killed near Sebzewar and Husayn beaten in Afghanistan.

wars.name: Qazaghan’s sack of Herat
wars.outcome: Qazaghan 'made Herat a tributary in 1351' and led a coalition that sacked it in the 1350s; no land was annexed.

wars.name: Timur and Husayn against Ilyas Khoja
wars.outcome: Ilyas Khoja 'attacked Timur in 1364 and was defeated on the Syr Darya', retreating the next year after an epidemic; Transoxiana stayed with Timur and Husayn.

certainty.note: Oasis and steppe frontiers; the pages give no line for any of the three phases.
